Aoto's first release: a YouTube Music player for Android, written in Rust, in Material You.

Aoto is built on [BitChord](https://github.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord) and its Rust rewrite, [BitChord PC Official](https://github.com/jackychan4891/BitChord-PC-Official) and its contributors. Thank you to all of them.

**New in this release**
- A Material You look throughout, with an indigo colour scheme and a new icon (a drop with a sound wave in it), including a themed icon for Android 13 and up.
- Gapless playback, playback speed (0.5× to 2×) with or without the pitch kept, an equalizer, and a sleep timer.
- Download a whole album or playlist at once, on Wi-Fi only if you like.
- Lyric cards: pick up to four lines and save or share them as a picture.
- Listening stats, kept on the device.
- Home-screen widgets (4×2, 2×2, 4×1), Android Auto, and a "Play on" control for where the sound goes.

**Things to know**
- Aoto installs next to BitChord as a separate app, so sign in again and download again.
- The widgets, Android Auto, Play on, and saving and sharing lyric cards are new and have been tried on few devices. Please report what breaks.
- Automatic update checks are off until Aoto has a repository to read releases from.
